# Parameter keys of Heimat 0.14.0: those of 0.13.0 plus the DJ filter and
# Restart Mods On Clock. A key is never renamed or removed, and an enum never
# loses options or changes their order, so saved sessions and patches keep
# working. The modulation routes are saved apart, as "mod_routes"
# (key:source:amount:polarity). Columns: key type options
gene_size float 0
slide float 0
morph float 0
vari_speed float 0
organize float 0
volume float 0
pad_mode enum 3
play_mode enum 3
release_ms float 0
root_note int 0

bend_range int 0
splice_base int 0
splice_source enum 2
divide int 0
organize_mode enum 2
gene_window enum 6
mcr1 float 0
mcr2 float 0
mcr3 float 0
sos float 0
in_gain enum 4
rec_source enum 2
rec_sync enum 2
clock_source enum 4
clock_div enum 5
bpm int 0
clock_mode enum 3
mute enum 2
save_48k enum 2
scatter float 0
spread float 0
width float 0
threshold float 0
thr_mode enum 3
eq_low float 0
eq_mid float 0
eq_freq float 0
eq_high float 0
rev_size float 0
rev_predelay float 0
